story.zh: 曹操攻破邺城，袁尚北逃幽州投奔袁熙。曹操欲肃清袁尚余部，遂召袁谭合兵，共攻袁熙。
story.en: Cao Cao breaches Ye, and Yuan Shang flees north to You Province to seek refuge with Yuan Xi. Seeking to purge the remnants of Yuan Shang's forces, Cao Cao summons Yuan Tan to join forces and launch a joint attack against Yuan Xi.

trigger.zh: 曹操存活，袁谭存活。郭嘉、徐晃、张辽在曹操麾下。邺属曹操，南皮属袁谭，昌黎属蹋顿。
trigger.en: Cao Cao is alive, Yuan Tan is alive. Guo Jia, Xu Huang, and Zhang Liao are under Cao Cao's command. Ye belongs to Cao Cao, Nanpi belongs to Yuan Tan, Changli belongs to Tadun.

forbidden.zh: 主角为袁谭势力武将时无法触发剧情。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is an Officer of Yuan Tan's Faction.

force.zh: 曹操身为君主并占领<邺>
force.en: Cao Cao is Ruler and occupies <Ye>

force.zh: 袁谭身为君主并占领<南皮>
force.en: Yuan Tan is Ruler and controls <Nanpi>.

force.zh: 蹋顿身为君主并占领<昌黎>

force.en: Guo Jia returns to Cao Cao's Faction

force.zh: 王修、管统回归袁谭势力
force.en: Wang Xiu and Guan Tong return to Yuan Tan's Faction.
